protocol.dataset: 30 frozen synthetic wardrobes, 180 requests; reused development data, not held out.
protocol.oracle: Owned, reviewed, unique, complete shapes and low-use constraints. Occasion is measured separately as exact tag compatibility; v2 treats it as soft preference, Assignment 3 treated it as hard.
protocol.timing: One in-process sample per request, includes first-run initialization. Quick RAG uses BM25 and deterministic plans; no LLM or network. Not a cloud latency benchmark.
